fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the execution of CustomShellHost.exe where the child isn't located in 'C:\Windows\explorer.exe'. CustomShellHost is a known LOLBin that can be abused by attackers for defense evasion techniques.
fields.name: Suspicious CustomShellHost Execution
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (src.process.image.path contains "\\CustomShellHost.exe" and (not tgt.process.image.path="C:\\Windows\\explorer.exe")))
